description: Pedal-1: the Eagan Matrix's pedal 1 — what the pedal controls, its range, and a virtual pedal that can be played from the panel or from a cable

params.text: Picks what the pedal controls, as one of the device's control codes; click to step forward, hold Ctrl and click to step back, or right-click for the whole list
Sets the pedal's value, 0 to 127; drag the handle, click anywhere on the bar, or roll the wheel over it
Sets the lowest value the pedal reaches, 0 to 127
Sets the highest value the pedal reaches, 0 to 127

inputs.text: Sets the pedal value from a cable, 0V to 10V across the pedal's range

outputs.text: The pedal's current value as 0V to 10V, whether it was moved by a real pedal or on the panel

notes: this module does nothing on its own: it needs an HC-1 in the patch, which it finds by itself, so it can be placed anywhere in the rack rather than beside it
with the mouse over the value bar, Home and End jump to the top and bottom, Page Up and Page Down move by ten, the arrow keys move by one, and the number keys 1 to 0 step across the range
the image under the value shows which pedal the device has detected, and hovering over it names that pedal; some pedals are only recognised once they have been moved
the three buttons beside the value bar jump to the top, the middle and the bottom of the range, and are drawn by the module rather than built as knobs, so no click on them reaches this help

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the virtual pedal on the panel.
